title: Demetrius
summary: Raleigh names Demetrius in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). The Demetrius he calls one of the sonnes of Antiochus the great, against whom Alexander made war. The other Demetrius named in this chapter were not attached. See N61. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VII, §. III, subsection IV, sig. 221b
